UPDATE multiremi_tasks SET updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?
SELECT * FROM multiremi_tasks WHERE id = ?

SELECT runtime.*, profile.display_name AS daemon_display_name FROM multiremi_runtimes runtime LEFT JOIN multiremi_daemon_profiles profile ON profile.workspace_id = COALESCE(runtime.workspace_id, 'local') AND profile.daemon_id = runtime.daemon_id WHERE runtime.id = ?
SELECT * FROM multiremi_access_tokens WHERE token_hash = ?
SELECT id, status, usage FROM multiremi_tasks WHERE runtime_id = ?
SELECT * FROM multiremi_task_messages WHERE task_id = ? AND seq >= ? AND seq <= ? ORDER BY seq ASC
SELECT group_id FROM multiremi_execution_group_members WHERE runtime_id = ? ORDER BY provider
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) AS seq FROM multiremi_task_messages WHERE task_id = ?
UPDATE multiremi_access_tokens SET last_used_at = ? WHERE id = ?
SELECT id FROM multiremi_autopilot_runs WHERE task_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM multiremi_runtime_models WHERE runtime_id = ? ORDER BY is_default DESC, label ASC
